request.state:
BRAEMONT PUMPS — FIELD FAILURE INVESTIGATION FF-26-0412
Failed part: shaft seal cartridge, part number SC-K7, from a KX-40 circulation pump returned by a district-heating customer after 7 months in service. The supplier batch label was destroyed by heat; the cartridge body carries no supplier marking. Failure mode determined by the lab: radial seal-face crack ("seal crack").

Supply data for SC-K7 (purchasing, deliveries into the KX-40 line for the relevant build period, January–June 2026):
  Halvorsen Polymer AS ........ 55 % of SC-K7 cartridges
  Ortega Seal Works S.L. ...... 30 %
  Kuznets Technik GmbH ........ 15 %
(For the SC-K9 cartridge used in the larger KX-60 pump, the split is Halvorsen 20 %, Ortega 50 %, Kuznets 30 %.)

Field failure rates of SC-K7 within 12 months in service (quality database, 2024–2026 builds, all failure modes):
  Halvorsen 0.8 % · Ortega 3.0 % · Kuznets 2.0 %
Failure-mode mix of those field failures (share of each supplier's SC-K7 failures that were seal cracks; the remainder were O-ring extrusion, spring fatigue or contamination):
  Halvorsen 20 % · Ortega 10 % · Kuznets 90 %
Quality engineer's note: failure rate and failure mode are recorded per supplier and are stable across build years; nothing else in the pump's history (installation, water chemistry within spec) distinguishes the suppliers.
Supplier scorecard, 2025 (all parts supplied to Braemont, not only SC-K7): Halvorsen 98.9 % good, Ortega 96.1 %, Kuznets 99.2 %.

decision.instructions: Which supplier made the failed SC-K7 cartridge in FF-26-0412? Give probabilities that reflect the evidence in the state.

criteria.halvorsen_polymer: The cartridge was supplied by Halvorsen Polymer AS.
criteria.kuznets_technik: The cartridge was supplied by Kuznets Technik GmbH.
criteria.ortega_seal_works: The cartridge was supplied by Ortega Seal Works S.L.
